solution:
Using $\tan(A+B)=\dfrac{\tan A+\tan B}{1-\tan A\tan B}$,
$$\tan(\tan^{-1}2+\tan^{-1}3)=\frac{2+3}{1-6}=-1.$$
The sum lies in $(\pi/2,\pi)$, so it equals $\dfrac{3\pi}{4}$.
